mcp.disabled: The server is turned off in Connections.

mcp.notUnicode: A path of the server is not valid Unicode.
mcp.programNotFound: {{program}} was not found on the PATH or in the worktree.
mcp.programMoved: {{program}} now leads into the project’s repository or off this computer, so it was not started. Choose its program again on the Connections page.
mcp.reservedVariable: {{variable}} is a variable Codex itself needs, so a secret cannot be handed over in it.
mcp.scriptArgument: Argument {{position}} would be changed by cmd.exe on its way through the server’s command script.
mcp.secretArchived: A variable takes its value from {{secret}}, which is archived.
mcp.secretMissing: A variable takes its value from a secret this project no longer has.
mcp.secretUnreadable: The system keychain did not give the value of {{secret}}. The runner log says why.
mcp.sharedVariable: Another server of this agent takes {{variable}} from a different secret, and Codex hands its servers one value per name.
mcp.title: Working without MCP server {{server}}
mcp.toolRelaysMissing: Codex reached Orchester’s tools {{reached}} of the {{started}} times it starts them; the agent may have worked without them.

problem.checkpointFailed: The step’s changes could not be committed
problem.cliTooOld: Claude Code {{installed}} can’t run {{model}}; version {{required}} or newer is needed
problem.cliTooOldDetail: The model’s provider refused this CLI version. Update Claude Code, or point the connection at a newer one, then check the connection again.
problem.codebaseIndexUnavailable: The codebase index is unavailable; the agent works without it
problem.codexSettingsIgnored: This branch has .codex/ settings; Orchester ignores them
problem.codexSettingsIgnoredDetail: Codex loaded no configuration, hooks, rules or MCP servers from {{folder}}. Its skills follow Repository agent files. Your own Codex settings still apply.
problem.contextCompacted: The conversation was shortened to fit the model’s context window
problem.contextCompactedDetail: A summary replaced the earlier turns: about {{before}} tokens became about {{after}}. The agent reads files again before it changes them.
problem.deniedByAutomation: Automation denied it through Orchester’s MCP server. The agent was told and continued.
problem.deniedByYou: You denied it. The agent was told and continued.
problem.memoryContainsSecret: It contains the value of the secret {{secret}}. Secret values are never kept in memory.
problem.memoryKeychainUnavailable: The system keychain could not be read to check it for the value of the secret {{secret}}.
problem.memoryNotSaved: The step’s handoff was not saved to task memory
problem.memoryScanFailed: Task memory could not be checked for unreadable records; the agent started all the same
problem.memoryStorageFailed: The project database could not store it: {{detail}}

memoryUnreadable.one: {{count}} memory record could not be read
memoryUnreadable.other: {{count}} memory records could not be read

problem.memoryUnreadableDetail: Agents get the other records. The unreadable ones stay in the project database as they are.
problem.mergeConflict: The step’s changes conflict with the run’s branch; they stay on {{branch}}
problem.modelRetrying: The model request failed; Orchester sends it again in {{seconds}} s (attempt {{attempt}})
problem.notAllowed: This run’s permissions do not allow it. The agent was told and continued without it.
problem.programNotFoundDetail: A command tool’s program is looked up in the folders of the PATH, or in the worktree when it is a relative path. Install the program or change the tool.
problem.programMovedDetail: The command tool’s program now leads into the project’s repository, which holds the worktrees agents write, or off this computer. Choose its program again on the Tools page.
problem.promptUnreachable: Orchester approvals were unavailable to Claude Code
problem.promptUnreachableDetail: Its permission prompt never reached the runner, so every action it asked about was denied without asking you. Nothing was approved.
problem.questionWithoutOptionsDetail: Orchester shows a question card only with at least two different suggested answers, so the question was declined and the agent was told to ask again with options or to end its turn with the question.

ripgrepFallback.gitGrep: Codex has no code index either; it searches the files with git grep.
ripgrepFallback.indexWithGitGrep: Codex still gets the code index; it searches the index and the files with git grep.
ripgrepFallback.indexWithOwnTools: Claude Code still gets the code index; it searches with its own search tools.
ripgrepFallback.ownTools: Claude Code has no code index either; it searches with its own search tools.

problem.ripgrepUnavailable: ripgrep could not be given to the agent
problem.runnerFailed: The runner could not record this run, so it was interrupted
problem.runnerFailedDetail: Nothing after the last checkpoint counts as done. Continue the run from it, or cancel it.
problem.secretQuestionDetail: Orchester never passes secret values through questions, so the question was declined and the agent was told why. Store the value in Secrets and grant it to this run; the agent can then use it without seeing it in the chat.
